character_reference_prompt: Studio portrait, automotive mechatronics technician, early-to-mid 30s, medium build, short dark hair, light stubble, navy-blue workshop polo with subtle chest logo patch, nitrile gloves, calm focused expression, neutral garage background, soft key light, shot on 50mm, shallow depth of field.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up on a car dashboard, a single warning light glowing amber in a dim garage interior. Rack focus to a gloved hand plugging a diagnostic scanner into the OBD port below the steering column. Cinematic, shallow depth of field, slight handheld motion, warm practical lighting from a work lamp.

Wide establishing shot of a modern automotive diagnostics workshop bay — clean concrete floor, a European sedan on a hydraulic lift, tool walls, morning light cutting through a garage door. Slow continuous dolly-in over 8 seconds. Documentary style, natural light, slightly desaturated cinematic grade.

Close tracking shot over a workbench: an EEPROM programmer with blinking LEDs in sharp focus, background soft. Slow lateral drift, tactile and textured, as if discovering the object for the first time.
Close tracking shot across a workbench: a laptop screen showing live sensor data graphs scrolling, reflected light on a gloved hand adjusting the trackpad. Shallow focus, slight handheld motion.
Close tracking shot: scattered job sheets and a multimeter on a workbench, a hand placing a probe down. Slow rack focus from foreground clutter to the multimeter's glowing display.
Extreme close-up, fault code readout scrolling fast on a diagnostic tablet screen, reflected light on lens. Static camera, screen glow only light source.
Extreme close-up on an EEPROM programmer's LED array cycling through read/write states. Macro lens look, shallow focus, slight rack focus across LEDs.
Close-up, oscilloscope waveform trace sweeping across screen in a dim workshop. Static camera, cool blue-green glow.

Medium shot of the reference technician in a workshop polo, studying a laptop screen showing a scrolling fault-code readout, brow furrowed in concentration. Behind him, blurred garage activity. Natural window light, 35mm lens look.
Close-up on the reference technician's face as concentration shifts to a flicker of recognition — eyes narrow slightly, faint nod. Natural light, same lens continuity as previous shot.
Candid medium shot: the reference technician leans back, laughs genuinely at something off-camera, wipes his hands on a shop rag. Warm, unposed, documentary handheld energy — not staged.

Slow push-in on a car pulling out of the workshop bay into bright daylight, dashboard warning light now off, visible through the windshield. Optimistic, resolved lighting shift from cool interior to warm exterior.
Static wide shot, empty daylight-lit workshop bay entrance, clean negative space in the lower third for a caption card. Slow, barely perceptible zoom — hold for text overlay in edit.
